transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net customer accounts and billing. My name is Raymond. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hello Raymond. I am calling to complain about a serious, recurring billing discrepancy on my account. When I signed up for our broadband six months ago, I selected paperless e-billing specifically to receive the ten-pound monthly discount. But I just checked my bank statements and realized S-Net has failed to apply the ten-pound discount on every single bill for the past six months, overcharging me sixty pounds!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I can certainly look into that paperless billing credit adjustment for you, Natalie. Can you please confirm the billing account reference number printed on your invoice header?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, the account reference is ACC-882104.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you Natalie. And what are the last four characters of your broadband router's MAC identifier printed on the underside barcode?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: The last four characters are 4B-9E. Raymond, I am registered disabled living on Personal Independence Payment and Employment Support Allowance, and sixty pounds is an enormous amount of money for someone on disability benefits! Over the winter I had to turn off my hallway storage heaters and sit in a winter coat indoors just to afford my groceries, all while S-Net was secretly taking ten pounds extra out of my bank account every month! I am in tears of anger and distress right now because sixty pounds could have kept my heating on for two entire weeks!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Ledger billing automation processes paperless credits via automated batch cycles across subscriber profile flags.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Why was the paperless discount flag turned off if I opted into paperless e-billing from day one?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: So if I have understood correctly, your paperless digital billing discount of ten pounds per month has not been credited to your invoices over the past six billing cycles, resulting in an accumulated overcharge of sixty pounds, and you require an immediate retrospective credit adjustment. Is that right?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, that is exactly what happened and what I need refunded.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Our billing software had an automated database migration glitch in May; S-Net customer service is not responsible for automated database coding bugs.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: S-Net is the company taking my money! You cannot blame computer code for taking money that doesn't belong to you!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I am examining the monthly invoice ledgers from May through October on our billing system.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: What do the monthly invoices show for the tariff charges?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Each of the six invoices shows a standard tariff charge of forty-five pounds without the ten-pound paperless e-billing credit applied.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: So that confirms beyond any doubt that sixty pounds total was overcharged.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The billing audit ledger confirms an aggregate credit deficit of sixty pounds across the six-month period.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Can you refund that sixty pounds directly back into my bank account today?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I can apply an immediate sixty-pound balance adjustment to your active billing account ledger, or initiate a BACS Faster Payments electronic refund.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Please initiate the Faster Payments transfer so the cash goes straight into my current account to help with my heating bills.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I am generating an electronic disbursement authorization under transaction voucher REF-66019.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: When will the sixty pounds reach my bank account?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The Faster Payments transfer releases within two hours of supervisor authorization today.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That is an immense relief. Now what about future bills? Will the ten-pound discount apply automatically from next month?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I have manually toggled the 'Paperless Digital Invoice Credit' promotional flag to ACTIVE on your subscriber tariff profile.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: So my future monthly bills will be thirty-five pounds instead of forty-five?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Your ongoing monthly recurring charge is locked at thirty-five pounds for the remaining eighteen months of your minimum term.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That will save me ten pounds every single month going forward.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: How many months has the paperless discount been missing from your invoices?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Raymond, as I stated in my very first sentence, it has been missing for the past six months! We just calculated sixty pounds based on six months!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I apologize, Natalie, I wanted to ensure our internal audit record matched your personal bank statement count.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, six months exactly: May, June, July, August, September, and October.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Understood. Let us also add an additional twenty-pound goodwill courtesy credit to your broadband account in recognition of the administrative delay.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you, Raymond. That twenty-pound goodwill credit is very kind and will reduce my next bill to only fifteen pounds.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I have posted the twenty-pound courtesy credit note to your ledger balance.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Can I receive an email confirmation showing both the sixty-pound refund and the twenty-pound courtesy credit?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: An automated billing adjustment summary statement has been generated and dispatched to your email address.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Checking my email... yes, the PDF confirmation has arrived showing both transactions clearly.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Obviously that confirms your account ledger is fully reconciled with corporate accounting standards, Natalie.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That gives me much greater confidence in S-Net's billing accuracy.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let us check your Direct Debit mandate on file to ensure Faster Payments refund routing aligns with your bank records.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: My bank details are Lloyds Bank, sort code 30-94-77, account ending in 5510.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Sort code 30-94-77 aligns with Lloyds Bank PLC and matches the active Direct Debit mandate.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That is my dedicated PIP and pension current account.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let us set up automated SMS payment pre-notifications so you receive a text message five days before your Direct Debit date.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That will be extremely helpful so I always know the exact collection date and amount in advance.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I have activated the five-day SMS advance billing notification alert on your mobile telephone.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That will keep my banking completely organized.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let us also check the itemized billing breakdown options on your customer account so future invoices list every call and data line item separately.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, I prefer to see the exact breakdown of every line item on my monthly PDF statement.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I have configured full itemized billing on your electronic statement delivery template free of charge.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That will make it very easy to cross-reference with my bank direct debits.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let us check your broadband line status while your account file is open on our system.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Our broadband connection has been completely stable; we have had zero dropouts.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The line is synchronized at sixty-four megabits per second download and sixteen megabits upload with zero packet errors.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: The speed is plenty fast enough for streaming TV and video calls with my grandchildren.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let us check the WiFi signal distribution across your bungalow to make sure your video calls do not buffer in the conservatory.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Looking at my iPad in the conservatory... it shows full three bars of WiFi on the 5 gigahertz network.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The Hub 5's smart channel optimization has selected interference-free channel thirty-six.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: The wireless coverage reaches every corner of our home.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let us also check your accessibility register preferences to record your PIP disability status on our Priority Services Register.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, please add me to the Priority Services Register so S-Net knows I need prioritized line restoration during any network outages.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I have enrolled your account on the S-Net Priority Services Register with disability priority tier A.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That provides tremendous peace of mind for the winter months.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Just to reconfirm, the refund amount scheduled for immediate electronic release is sixty pounds, alongside twenty pounds courtesy credit on the account.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, sixty pounds cash refund and twenty pounds credit note. That is completely correct.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: If automated database glitches alter your discount again in future, do not contact S-Net customer service as automated coding errors are an IT database issue.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Wait, who else would I contact if not customer service? That makes no sense, Raymond.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Wait, before you go, how will this credit appear on my next monthly PDF invoice? Will it show under...

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: It will show on the invoice. Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Wait, Raymond, don't hang up... hello? He hung up on me!
